name: Mysteriously Elected
body:
Your divine power is growing.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 15, Godstouched, Mysteriously Chosen, character level 9th.

Benefit(s): You gain a new revelation from the mystery you selected with the Mysteriously Chosen feat.

This revelation must be available to a 7th-level oracle. For purposes of using that revelation, treat your oracle level as equal to your character level – 2, even if you have levels in oracle.
